title: Platformer
description: A 2D side-scrolling platformer built with Lua and LOVE2D, circa 2011. Jump, shoot, grapple.
description_html: A 2D side-scrolling platformer built with Lua and LOVE2D circa 2011. Jump, shoot, grapple your way through tile-based maps.
features: Side-scrolling movement — run, jump, and grapple through levels
Tile-based maps — collision detection via pixel-color map layers
Shooting — fire projectiles in your facing direction
Camera tracking — scrolls with the player through large maps
Web build — plays in the browser via love.js (WASM)
